form.title: SCRATCH-BCR: single-cell BCR (10x VDJ-B)
form.description: Cell Ranger VDJ (--chain IG) -> IgBLAST/IMGT re-annotation -> BCR QC -> SCOPer clones per patient -> germlines, SHM and dowser lineage trees -> per-cell BCR object. Output bridge/merged_bcr_object/post_qc_cells.tsv joins onto the SCRATCH GEX .h5ad with SCRATCH-TCRmerge (Receptor = BCR), alongside TCRtoolkit's TCR table.

input_type.title: Start from
input_type.description: fastq: raw 10x 5' VDJ-B FASTQs (Cell Ranger runs here). cellranger: an existing Cell Ranger vdj/multi output dataset (filtered_contig_annotations.csv + filtered_contig.fasta per sample). With a modality column in the sample sheet, only BCR rows are used.

genome.title: Genome
genome.description: GRCh38 = human, GRCm39 = mouse. Sets the Cell Ranger VDJ reference and the IMGT/IgBLAST species.

vdj_reference.title: Cell Ranger VDJ reference (S3 folder, optional)
vdj_reference.description: Leave blank to use s3://btc-refdata/scratch/refdata-cellranger-vdj-GRCh38-alts-ensembl-7.1.0 (GRCh38) or the GRCm38 equivalent. Set an s3:// folder containing reference.json and fasta/regions.fa to override. FASTQ input only.

bcr_drop_multi_heavy.title: Drop cells with >1 heavy chain
bcr_drop_multi_heavy.description: Two productive heavy chains in one barcode is usually a doublet. Immcantation's recommendation.

bcr_require_heavy.title: Require a heavy chain
bcr_require_heavy.description: Clones are defined on the heavy chain; light-only cells cannot be assigned.

bcr_multi_light.title: Cells with >1 light chain
bcr_multi_light.description: keep_top keeps the highest-UMI light chain.

clone_by.title: Group samples by (column)
clone_by.description: Sample-sheet column naming the subject. All samples of one subject are pooled, so a clone seen at several timepoints gets one clone_id.

clonal_threshold.title: Distance threshold
clonal_threshold.description: auto fits it per subject with SHazaM; or a number such as 0.15.

clonal_threshold_fallback.title: Fallback threshold
clonal_threshold_fallback.description: Used when a subject has too few related cells for the auto fit.

run_shm.title: Somatic hypermutation
run_shm.description: Germline reconstruction + mutation frequency per sequence. A few minutes per subject.

lineage_build.title: Tree method
lineage_build.description: pratchet: parsimony, minutes. pml: maximum likelihood, slower. igphyml: B-cell SHM model, most accurate, hours.

lineage_max_clones.title: Max trees per patient (largest clones first; 0 = all)

input_gex_object.title: GEX Seurat object (.rds)
input_gex_object.description: If given, also writes seurat/bcr_gex_seurat.rds: this object with bcr_* columns added. For large cohorts use SCRATCH-TCRmerge on the .h5ad instead (no R matrix-size limit).
